title: Instant virtual credit card
requirement: We want existing Demo Bank customers to get a virtual credit card instantly in the app, so they can start shopping online right away. The limit is decided automatically. The physical card is sent later to the customer's address. There is no annual fee in the first year.

expectations.description: Asks how the limit is calculated and its min/max
Asks which existing customers are eligible
Asks about the address used for the physical card
Asks what fee applies after the first year
Raises secure display of card details (PAN/CVV)
Has a UAT case for a customer who is not eligible
Has a UAT case for using the virtual card online
